description: Generic legal document — used as a fallback when the document type doesn't match a specific taxonomy

clauses.name: Parties
clauses.description: Who are the parties to this agreement and their roles

medium: One party is a shell entity or unclear corporate structure
low: All parties clearly identified with roles defined

clauses.name: Obligations
clauses.description: Key obligations of each party under the agreement

low: Clear, balanced, and specific obligations for all parties

high: No defined term — perpetual by default
medium: Long term with limited exit options
low: Clear fixed term with reasonable renewal provisions

clauses.name: Termination
clauses.description: How the agreement can be ended

medium: Termination allowed but with excessive penalties
low: Balanced termination rights with reasonable notice

clauses.name: Liability and Indemnification
clauses.description: Limitations on liability and indemnification obligations

high: One party has unlimited liability while the other has none
medium: Standard limitation of liability with some gaps
Mandatory arbitration but in reasonable location
low: Mediation first, then standard legal process

clauses.name: Governing Law
clauses.description: Which jurisdiction's laws apply to this agreement

high: Governing law in unfamiliar or distant jurisdiction
low: Governing law in a relevant, accessible jurisdiction
